agents.description: Globally align two protein sequences (affine gaps) and report identity over aligned columns, coverage, gaps and score. Runs the project's own aligner on the user's CPU.
agents.name: align_sequences

parameters.gap_extend: optional: penalty magnitude per gap residue (default 0.5)
parameters.gap_open: optional: penalty magnitude to open a gap (default 10)
parameters.sequence_a: one-letter residue codes; whitespace is ignored
parameters.sequence_b: one-letter residue codes; whitespace is ignored

agents.description: Distance, angle, torsion or centroid from explicit coordinates, using the project's geometry code. Coordinates are angstroms.
agents.name: geometry_measure

parameters.measure: distance (2 points), angle (3, vertex second), dihedral (4) or centroid
parameters.points: 'x, y, z' triples separated by ';', for example '0,0,0; 3,4,0'

agents.description: The ten pipeline interfaces in protocol order, with which can run in this browser, which only partly, and which need an external program that a browser cannot run. Read-only.
agents.name: pipeline_catalog
agents.wraps: eagent.harness.registry (interface registry) and the roadmap's status table

agents.description: Run the project's own deterministic controller on a task, on this device with the network off and no approvals: it runs each interface that can run here (the reaction step first) until the first human decision point, then reports what each step found (status, blocking problems, open questions) and which decision it is waiting on. It cannot clear that decision or fill a field; only a named person can.
agents.name: run_pipeline

parameters.task: optional: the id of a shipped task, for example KRED_PILOT_001
parameters.task_yaml: optional: the text of a task file (instead of task), up to 6000 characters

agents.description: Distance between two sequences in [0, 1], by k-mer Jaccard (no alignment needed) or Hamming (equal-length aligned sequences).
agents.name: sequence_distance

parameters.k: optional: k-mer size for kmer_jaccard, 1 to 8 (default 3)
parameters.sequence_a: one-letter residue codes; whitespace is ignored
parameters.sequence_b: one-letter residue codes; whitespace is ignored

agents.description: Read-only: which fields of a task are still unresolved for each of the three human decision points, and which pipeline steps they block. Uses the project's own validator. It cannot resolve a field or approve anything.
agents.name: task_gate_report

parameters.task: optional: the id of a shipped task, for example KRED_PILOT_001
parameters.task_yaml: optional: the text of a task file (instead of task), up to 6000 characters

agents.description: Check substitutions such as 'A123G' against a parent sequence: is the wild-type residue really at that position? Catches mis-numbered or invented mutations before they reach an order sheet.
agents.name: variant_check

parameters.first_position: optional: the number of the first residue in the sequence (default 1)
parameters.variants: substitutions separated by commas, spaces, ';' or '/', e.g. 'Y190F, H150N'

agents.description: Wilson score interval for successes out of trials, honest at 0 and all successes where the textbook interval collapses to zero width.
agents.name: wilson_interval

pipeline.description: Normalise a reaction brief into a typed ReactionSpec, validate the atom mapping, and report every field that is still unresolved.
pipeline.note: Runs fully offline. A structure must be confirmed by a person; a prose name is a blocker, not a guess.

pipeline.description: Build an auditable query plan, extract typed experiment records from the cached sources, and publish the family x chemotype evidence matrix.
pipeline.note: Cache-first. The engine makes no network calls, so it reads cached evidence only; with an empty cache it reports its query gaps and no records.

pipeline.description: Multi-seed homology and profile search against local sequence databases, with de-duplication, greedy clustering and honest coverage reporting.
pipeline.note: Reports tool_unavailable and produces nothing rather than a heuristic that imitates the search.

pipeline.description: Family assignment from identity, domain architecture, conserved positions and catalytic residue correspondence, with per-family catalytic mapping, a similarity network and an alignment hand-off.
pipeline.note: Needs seed accessions and references that sequence mining supplies.

pipeline.description: Choose a structure per candidate by an explicit source priority, QC it against the candidate sequence and the catalytic template, and record pocket-local confidence
pipeline.needs: a structure predictor and a local structure index
pipeline.note: Reports tool_unavailable; no structure is invented.

pipeline.description: Build and index complete catalytic complexes (protein + substrate + correctly-reduced cofactor + metals) by template-guided docking and by joint complex prediction
pipeline.needs: a docking program or a joint complex predictor
pipeline.note: Reports tool_unavailable; a failed or absent model is never recorded as an experimental negative.

pipeline.description: Per-pose mechanism geometry against a sourced catalytic template, with pocket-localisation QC, chemoselectivity and cofactor-state checks, circularity-corrected robustness (G counted only over gating constraints that were not restrained during modelling, and undefined rather than 1.0 when none were), a directional stereochemical call and a per-candidate scorecard with no total.
pipeline.note: Reads poses it is given. Every verdict is caveated, because the template windows are uncalibrated.

pipeline.description: Compose a round under the construct budget: three candidate roles, family and clade quotas, attributable variant groups, a claim-checked control plan, and the plate cost made visible before the order.
pipeline.note: Pure selection. Opens no socket, and submitting an order is refused outright.

pipeline.description: Ingest assay results into the full outcome taxonomy under the pre-registered criterion, keep negatives in the learning update, and produce a structured no-hit differential.
pipeline.note: Reads plate results into typed records. It has never read a real plate.

pipeline.description: Round-2 mutation proposals from experimentally confirmed parents: three evidence classes, a verified freeze policy, per-axis expectations and single-mutant decomposition controls.
pipeline.note: The rational and literature-precedent paths run here; the inverse-folding path needs the program.
